beforeEveryWrite: verify current or explicit target branch is exactly kimi
read canonical governance and status files
inspect pending differences and task acceptance
stop with BLOCKED when any verification is unavailable or contradictory

sourceOfTruthOrder: task-specific acceptance and evidence under quality-reviews
verified Vercel deployment tied to the same commit
sessionPreflight: identify the exact task and current authorized step
read the source-of-truth files in order
verify the latest commit and deployment relationship
define or load the task acceptance matrix
state IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED, or PASS from evidence rather than assumption
productionLoop: define expected user-visible outcome, comparison target, failure conditions, and test environment
research material facts and current references when required
inspect the actual artifact at the user's viewport and normal speed
audit code architecture, data integrity, performance, save compatibility, accessibility, and maintainability
audit interaction feel, responsiveness, readability, feedback, error recovery, and continuity
run an independent critic whose goal is to reject the artifact
repair accepted findings and repeat all affected checks
run regression and bind evidence to an exact kimi commit and deployment
allow the final judge to issue PASS only when every applicable gate passes

insufficientByThemselves: the screen resembles the mockup in source code
the implementation was generated without errors
requiredGates: G3 human expectation and five-second comprehension
G4 comparison and adversarial rejection review
G5 normal end-to-end use, failure, resume, save, and target-environment evidence
additionalGameEvidence: final-size visual review on target iPhone viewport
save, resume, offline reward, and migration testing
performance, memory, battery, and thermal observations where physically measurable
comparison against the approved visual reference and strong commercial competitors
completionContract.physicalEvidenceRule: Never claim physical iPhone approval, touch feel, battery, thermal, haptics, or production readiness without evidence from the exact tested commit and URL.
completionContract.userRejectionRule: Any user rejection invalidates the previous PASS for the rejected scope and returns it to IN_PROGRESS.
completionContract.passAuthority: Only the final judge may issue PASS after creator and independent critic evidence is complete.

roles.creator: Builds against the acceptance matrix and does not self-certify completion.
roles.independentCritic: Attempts to reject the result using user expectations, strong comparisons, edge cases, and actual output.
roles.finalJudge: Ignores effort and checks only whether the exact artifact is safe to present as complete.

userIsOnlyNeededFor: a genuine preference tie that changes product direction
credentials or permissions unavailable to ChatGPT
destructive, paid, publishing, or public-scope approval
physical iPhone actions and subjective feel evidence that tools cannot perform
userBoundary.forbiddenDelegation: Do not ask the user to write code, diagnose ordinary defects, compare routine screenshots, or act as the default QA department.
